# MCP JSON schemas

The official JSON schemas of the Model Context Protocol, revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28, copied unchanged from
`schema/<revision>/schema.json` of <https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol> at commit `ff465f00f0`
(Apache-2.0, partly MIT). The request specs of the MCP server validate its answers against them.
